comment: McWhorter is a very solid professor. Im sure her class would have been much better in person but overall was still fine online. Reading intensive as many lib art classes are but there was a lot of good information and she is very reasonable. 3 major papers and a final make up your grade but papers are not difficult. Final is what hurt my grade
Prof McWhorter is very nice and knowledgable, lots of discussions and reasonable assignments. VERY highly recommended.

TAKE HER CLASS! ANY OF THEM! Dr. McWhorter is probably the smartest person I have ever met but she makes course material interesting and easy to understand. She has the biggest heart and is so supportive of her students. She is kind, funny, passionate, smart. If everyone were more like Dr. McWhorter, the world would be a better place. I ADORE HER!

Dr. McWhorter wants to see all students do well and bases class discussions on what students have questions about/their answers to weekly online posts. She doesn't just summarize the reading assigned for homework. Definitely should take notes and pay attention in class, very interesting and informative!

McWhorter is amazing. She gives a moderate reading but good about answering any questions you have regarding it. There were discussion posts to do that can be a little confusing but are meant to concentrate your focus and aren't graded based on accuracy/understanding. She is very caring. She wants to see her students do well in this class.

A lot of reading the first half of the semester to introduce themes and ideas. The readings were somewhat dense, but they helped give an overview of the topics WGSS covers. Prof. McWhorter is very quirky and great at giving more explanation to help make the topics understandable. As long as you put some effort in it shouldn't be too challenging.
Good professor. We cover some interesting topics. Not an Easy A because she is a hard grader but there is not much work overall.
Incredible smart and laid back. Do your reading and ask questions if you're confused. It's tough material, but she explains it well.

She is very articulate, open minded, and understanding. If you think you may have trouble with some of the complex philosophical concepts and want to have a very encouraging, very helpful philosophy experience, take her! Her lectures are crystal clear and engaging, she is humble and welcoming to any and all comments.

Great teacher.  Some of the material is hard, but all of it is interesting.  She lectures fast and furiously, but with opportunities for discussion at the conclusion.  Neat but time-consuming character project.  I love that she gets angry about important issues and lets us see that - makes a safe(r) space for rage.  Feminist and GLBTQ supporter.
very precise and fun lecturer. dances in class ^.* before you realize, the class is over!

Easily one of the best teachers at U of R. Funny, brilliant, and a great lecturer. She takes really weighty, difficult material and makes it easily comprehensible. Very challenging reading, but her lectures and discussions are amazing. Flexible, manageable workload, but a long term paper. No tests, good essay topics. Possibly my favorite professor.
Best lecturer I've had in Phil. Dept. Very fun, and energetic. Tough but even-handed. Class discussion was excellent. Great Class.
if you don't believe her beliefs or she doesn't like you, then it's a hard class and just not worth it
Fantastic teacher.  Hard readings at a fast pace and she explains all of it well.  She facilitates class discussion very well.
It's a hard class, some of the books were really boring.  She was very unhelpful.
She knows her stuff and is really cool. The reading is difficult but if you pay attention she explains everything extremely well.

she's really smart, and she gave really interesting and unconventional assignments.  there's a lot of work, but there's not big research paper, all of the assignments are smaller, and they're more of reaction papers than reading related.
